question: What further auspicious teaching is sought regarding the power of time?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear more.
The sought teaching is the auspicious overcoming of time.
inference: The speaker requests the auspicious teaching on overcoming time.
uncertainties: vañcanaṃ can mean deception or evasion; here it implies overcoming or outwitting time.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious teaching on overcoming time.
